summary: Coordinate regulatory impact analysis, prioritisation and implementation tracking. Build a reusable change playbook with TrainingCred.
lede: Regulatory change management helps compliance, risk and regulatory affairs professionals assess new obligations and coordinate implementation across teams. The course covers change intake and applicability screening, cross-functional impact analysis and risk-based prioritisation, then applies these skills to assign owners, plan actions and track implementation evidence through a reusable playbook.
audienceIntro: This advanced course suits professionals who already work with compliance obligations, enterprise risk, regulatory policy or cross-functional implementation. It is designed for people who need to coordinate requirement interpretation and delivery across teams rather than manage a single regulation in isolation.
modules: ESG and Basel III Change Evidence
prerequisites: Prior professional experience in compliance, regulatory affairs, enterprise risk, government policy or programme delivery is recommended. You should be able to work with internal policies, process descriptions or control information; coding is not required.
